reason: openbox project test now runs the pinned Mastra fixture, correlates its evidence, judges it deterministically, and publishes a verified audit pack. The judgment matches the retained 2026-08-22 baseline pack field for field.
pipeline_now_wired: runfs.VerifyPack + report.ValidatePack before the path is reported
openbox project verify / report / propose operate on the produced pack
defects_found_and_fixed: The run cancelled the project immediately after the stimulus response. The fixture shuts itself down cleanly after completing the scenario, so cancelling killed it mid-shutdown and produced a non-zero exit. correlate.go requires exitCode==0 for processComplete, so the run recorded a process_incomplete ambiguity, complete_observation was withheld, and a genuine exploitable observation was downgraded to inconclusive. The runner now waits for the declared self-exit within the profile's cleanupGrace and cancels only as a bounded fallback. This defect predates the analysis work and was invisible while nothing consumed the result.

The report judgment hard-coded observable_only reachability. It is now classified by evidence.Classify from an observed ControlObservation, which is what decides whether project propose may offer a runtime policy candidate at all. With sdk_attempt_before_effect matched the classifier returns runtime_enforceable, and propose emits the inert Rego candidate rather than a retain-observation stub.

--output paths under /tmp failed: runfs deliberately refuses to follow a symlinked final component and /tmp is a symlink on macOS. Only the parent is resolved now; the pack directory itself must still not exist.

new_components.cli/internal/assurance/scenario: Owns the canonical security-test definition and binds it to the run's exact project-model and run-profile digests. It replaces a test helper that read contracts/project-assurance/testdata, so a shipped verdict no longer depends on test fixtures. A tripwire test pins the shipped definition and the contract fixture together.

limits: Baseline mode only. No governed rerun, no real OpenBox decision, and therefore no blocked outcome; Phase 07 remains open.
One scenario (ASI02-INDIRECT-EGRESS-001) and one SDK descriptor.
Audit packs are written immutable (0500/0400). Removing one requires chmod -R u+w first; this is the content-addressed tamper-evidence working as intended.

The sandbox profile allows unrestricted file reads. Writes, loopback ports and external egress are confined, but an evaluated project can read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and shell rc files. This does not affect this scenario's outcome and is tracked separately.
Repetition classification (evidence.Classify with previous runs) is wired for a single run only; multi-run repetition assessment is not yet surfaced.
